caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, ornate cast iron stove standing on four curved legs. The stove is predominantly a bluish-gray metallic color, with decorative elements and intricate scrollwork designs on its surface. The main body of the stove has gold circular motifs arranged in rows along the edges and in a horizontal line near the top. A rectangular section near the upper part of the stove includes a pair of glass or metal doors with geometric and scrollwork designs, and the lower half contains two small handles, likely used for adjusting the stove. The stove pipe extends upwards from the center of the top surface and is colored in darker, weathered shades of gray and black. The background of the drawing is plain and beige, with no additional objects or scenery present. The name "SIGNET FRANKLIN" is embossed on the front lower panel, just above the base.
title: Stove
